sites.scope: Hard-error plus process lifecycle correlation on the exact failed workload; debugger timing affects scheduling.
sites.limits: User-mode sites use preferred image bases and verify bytes when hit. Dynamic return sites are tied to the originating ETHREAD and exact saved return address. No changed return values or guest data. PnP interior sites record raw registers/global values, not fabricated call arguments. CloseHandle is retained only when services.exe closes the current saved token.
